fusiones.texto: Patrón City Across Two Centuries (Time-Split Composition) de image/patterns/poster-illustration.md, en versión de 5 slots y versión Nano Banana. Versión 5 slots: Scene: "wide establishing shot of {city_landmark_view}, frame divided vertically down the center — left half shows the scene in {historical_era}, right half shows {modern_era}".
